title: "To examine the short-term impact of RBI monetary policy changes on sectoral stock returns."

format: pdf
editor: visual

## Loading Data

```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

data_old <- list.files(path = "E:\\Project",pattern = "*.xlsx",full.names = TRUE)
data <- lapply(data_old,read_xlsx)
names(data) <- gsub(".xlsx", "", basename(data_old))
data
#All the datasets have been imported with their origial names in the vector "data"
```

## Calculating returns for each sector

```{r}
data <- lapply(data,function(df){
  df %>% arrange(Date)
})
names(data)[names(data)==("NIFTY IT")] <- 'NIFTY_IT'

repo_clean$Date <- as.Date(repo_clean$Date)

data$`NIFTY_IT` <- data$`NIFTY_IT` %>% 
  arrange(Date) %>% 
  mutate(Return=log(Close/lag(Close)))


data$NIFTY_AUTO <- data$NIFTY_AUTO %>% 
  arrange(Date) %>% 
  mutate(Return=log(Close/lag(Close)))

data$NIFTY_BANK <- data$NIFTY_BANK %>% 
  arrange(Date) %>% 
  mutate(Return=log(Close/lag(Close)))

data$NIFTY_FMCG <- data$NIFTY_FMCG %>% 
  arrange(Date) %>% 
  mutate(Return=log(Close/lag(Close)))

data$NIFTY_pharma <- data$NIFTY_pharma %>% 
  arrange(Date) %>% 
  mutate(Return=log(Close/lag(Close)))

data$NIFTY_REALTY <- data$NIFTY_REALTY %>% 
  arrange(Date) %>% 
  mutate(Return=log(Close/lag(Close)))

data$NIFTY50 <- data$NIFTY50 %>% 
  arrange(Date) %>% 
  mutate(Return=log(Close/lag(Close)))

```

## Combining datasets

```{r}
market_data <- data$NIFTY50 %>%
  select(Date, Market_Return = Return)

bank <- data$NIFTY_BANK
bank <- bank %>%
  left_join(market_data, by = "Date")
bank <- bank %>% filter(!is.na(Market_Return))

```

## Finding alpha and beta coefficients

```{r}
model_bank <- lm(Return ~ Market_Return, data = bank)
alpha <- coef(model_bank)[1]
beta <- coef(model_bank)[2]
summary(model_bank)
```

## Merging Repo Dates

```{r}
event_dates <- data$repo_clean$Date
head(event_dates)

get_event_window <- function(data, event_dates, window = 3) {
  index <- which(data$Date == event_dates)
  if (length(index) == 0) return(NULL)
  start <- index - window
  end   <- index + window
  if (start < 1 | end > nrow(data)) return(NULL)
  out <- data[start:end, ]
  out$Event_Time <- -window:window
  return(out)
}
event_windows <- lapply(event_dates, function(d) {
  get_event_window(bank, d, window = 3)
})


get_event_window <- function(df, event_dates, event_id, window = 3) {
  idx <- which(df$Date == event_dates)
  if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
  start <- idx - window
  end   <- idx + window
  if (start < 1 | end > nrow(df)) return(NULL)
  out <- df[start:end, ]
  out$Event_Time <- -window:window
  out$Event_ID   <- event_id
  out$Event_Date <- event_dates
  return(out)
}

event_windows <- lapply(seq_along(event_dates), function(i) {
  get_event_window(bank, event_dates[i], event_id = i, window = 3)
})

event_windows <- event_windows[!sapply(event_windows, is.null)]
event_data    <- bind_rows(event_windows)

nrow(event_data)
table(event_data$Event_Time)

event_data <- event_data %>%
  left_join(data$repo_clean %>% select(Date, Change),
            by = c("Event_Date" = "Date"))

```

## Abnormal Returns

```{r}
alpha_bank <- coef(model_bank)[1]
beta_bank <- coef(model_bank)[2]

event_data <- event_data %>%
  mutate(Expected_Return = alpha_bank + beta_bank * Market_Return,
    AR = Return - Expected_Return
  )
variable.names(event_data)

```

## CAR per event

```{r}
CAR_data <- event_data %>% 
  group_by(Event_ID,Event_Date,Change) %>% 
  summarise(CAR=sum(AR),.groups = "drop")

nrow(CAR_data)
head(CAR_data)

```

## CAR in hikes and cuts

```{r}
CAR_data <- CAR_data %>%
  mutate(Direction = ifelse(Change > 0, "Hike", "Cut"))

CAR_data %>%
  group_by(Direction) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_CAR = mean(CAR),
    N = n()
  )

```

## t-tests

```{r}
# Overall
t.test(CAR_data$CAR, mu = 0)

# Hikes only
t.test(CAR_data$CAR[CAR_data$Direction == "Hike"], mu = 0)

# Cuts only
t.test(CAR_data$CAR[CAR_data$Direction == "Cut"], mu = 0)
```

## at the event day

```{r}
event_data %>%
  filter(Event_Time == 0) %>%
  summarise(Mean_AR = mean(AR),
            t_stat = mean(AR)/(sd(AR)/sqrt(n())),
            p_value = 2*pt(-abs(mean(AR)/(sd(AR)/sqrt(n()))), df=n()-1))
```

## For all sectors

```{r}
# Keep only essential columns inside run_event_study
# Add this as the FIRST line after creating sector object

run_event_study <- function(sector_name, data, market_data, 
                             repo_clean, event_dates, window = 3) {
  
  # Step 1: Align sector with market - keep only needed columns
  sector <- data[[sector_name]] %>%
    select(Date, Close, Return) %>%
    left_join(market_data, by = "Date") %>%
    filter(!is.na(Market_Return))
  
  # Step 2: Estimation window
  event_dates_all <- unlist(lapply(event_dates, function(d) {
    idx <- which(sector$Date == d)
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
    start <- max(1, idx - window)
    end   <- min(nrow(sector), idx + window)
    as.character(sector$Date[start:end])
  }))
  
  estimation <- sector %>%
    filter(!Date %in% as.Date(event_dates_all))
  
  # Step 3: Market model
  model <- lm(Return ~ Market_Return, data = estimation)
  alpha <- coef(model)[1]
  beta  <- coef(model)[2]
  
  # Step 4: Event windows
  get_window <- function(df, event_date, event_id, window) {
    idx <- which(df$Date == event_date)
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(NULL)
    start <- idx - window
    end   <- idx + window
    if (start < 1 | end > nrow(df)) return(NULL)
    out <- df[start:end, ]
    out$Event_Time <- -window:window
    out$Event_ID   <- event_id
    out$Event_Date <- as.Date(event_date)
    return(out)
  }
  
  windows <- lapply(seq_along(event_dates), function(i) {
    get_window(sector, event_dates[i], i, window)
  })
  windows <- windows[!sapply(windows, is.null)]
  event_data <- bind_rows(windows)
  
  # Step 5: AR and CAR
  repo_join <- repo_clean %>%
    mutate(Date = as.Date(Date)) %>%
    select(Date, Change)
  
  event_data <- event_data %>%
    mutate(Event_Date = as.Date(Event_Date)) %>%
    left_join(repo_join, by = c("Event_Date" = "Date")) %>%
    mutate(
      Expected_Return = alpha + beta * Market_Return,
      AR = Return - Expected_Return,
      Direction = ifelse(Change > 0, "Hike", "Cut"),
      Sector = sector_name
    )
  
  CAR_data <- event_data %>%
    group_by(Event_ID, Event_Date, Change, Direction) %>%
    summarise(CAR = sum(AR), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Sector = sector_name)
  
  # Step 6: t-tests
  overall <- t.test(CAR_data$CAR, mu = 0)
  hike    <- t.test(CAR_data$CAR[CAR_data$Direction == "Hike"], mu = 0)
  cut     <- t.test(CAR_data$CAR[CAR_data$Direction == "Cut"],  mu = 0)
  
  day0_ar <- event_data %>% filter(Event_Time == 0)
  day0    <- t.test(day0_ar$AR, mu = 0)
  
  list(
    sector        = sector_name,
    alpha         = alpha,
    beta          = beta,
    CAR_data      = CAR_data,
    event_data    = event_data,
    t_overall     = overall$p.value,
    t_hike        = hike$p.value,
    t_cut         = cut$p.value,
    t_day0        = day0$p.value,
    mean_CAR_hike = mean(CAR_data$CAR[CAR_data$Direction == "Hike"]),
    mean_CAR_cut  = mean(CAR_data$CAR[CAR_data$Direction == "Cut"])
  )
}

# Step 1: Run event study for all sectors
sectors <- c("NIFTY_BANK", "NIFTY_IT", "NIFTY_AUTO", 
             "NIFTY_FMCG", "NIFTY_pharma", "NIFTY_REALTY")


names(results) <- sectors

# Step 2: Summary table
summary_table <- do.call(rbind, lapply(results, function(r) {
  data.frame(
    Sector        = r$sector,
    Alpha         = round(r$alpha, 6),
    Beta          = round(r$beta, 4),
    Mean_CAR_Hike = round(r$mean_CAR_hike, 5),
    Mean_CAR_Cut  = round(r$mean_CAR_cut, 5),
    p_Overall     = round(r$t_overall, 4),
    p_Hike        = round(r$t_hike, 4),
    p_Cut         = round(r$t_cut, 4),
    p_Day0        = round(r$t_day0, 4)
  )
}))

print(summary_table)
```

## Plots

```{r}
all_event_data <- all_event_data %>%
  mutate(Sector = recode(Sector,
    "NIFTY_BANK"   = "Banking",
    "NIFTY_IT"     = "IT",
    "NIFTY_AUTO"   = "Auto",
    "NIFTY_FMCG"   = "FMCG",
    "NIFTY_pharma" = "Pharma",
    "NIFTY_REALTY" = "Realty"
  ))

all_CAR_data <- all_CAR_data %>%
  mutate(Sector = recode(Sector,
    "NIFTY_BANK"   = "Banking",
    "NIFTY_IT"     = "IT",
    "NIFTY_AUTO"   = "Auto",
    "NIFTY_FMCG"   = "FMCG",
    "NIFTY_pharma" = "Pharma",
    "NIFTY_REALTY" = "Realty"
  ))
ar_plot_data <- all_event_data %>%
  group_by(Sector, Event_Time) %>%
  summarise(Mean_AR = mean(AR), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(ar_plot_data, aes(x = Event_Time, y = Mean_AR, color = Sector)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~Sector, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Average Abnormal Returns Around RBI Policy Events",
       x = "Event Time (Days Relative to Announcement)",
       y = "Mean Abnormal Return") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = -3:3)
```

```{r}
car_summary <- all_CAR_data %>%
  group_by(Sector, Direction) %>%
  summarise(Mean_CAR = mean(CAR), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(car_summary, aes(x = Sector, y = Mean_CAR, fill = Direction)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge", width = 0.6) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Hike" = "#e74c3c", "Cut" = "#2ecc71")) +
  labs(title = "Mean CAR by Sector and Policy Direction",
       x = "Sector",
       y = "Mean Cumulative Abnormal Return",
       fill = "Policy Direction") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11))
```
